purpose: Vericairn's own releases: the software pack's release flow with the first-party estate's steps added, the NuGet packages observed, the MCP Registry listing and the release's announcement on GitHub Discussions and the operator's X account as reserved publication steps after publication, and the profile repository's documents cleared after the documentation pass. It names Vericairn's own destinations, so it is the first-party estate's content and never part of the software pack.
never: Never post, list or announce for the operator: the operator posts each announcement and confirms the listing, and closes its request with the observed link.

steps.title: NuGet packages observed
steps.action: The publication starts the NuGet workflow, which pushes the eight packages from the published release's own assets. Observe each once indexed: vericairn packages observe for every package of the product at the published version.
steps.recovery: A package still indexing is observed again later; a failed push is retried by the workflow with --skip-duplicate, and nothing replaces a version already present.

steps.title: Announcement drafted
steps.action: Draft the release's announcement for the Announcements category of GitHub Discussions and its summary for the operator's X account, at most 280 characters with a link counting 23, from the accepted release's notes; hand both on by hash for an independent review.
steps.recovery: A review's findings send the draft back; the operator posts only the reviewed text, by its hash.

steps.title: MCP Registry listing confirmed
steps.recovery: The publication starts the mcp-registry workflow, which lists the published dotnet-vc package as io.github.Vericairn/vericairn through GitHub's identity. If its run did not finish, the operator dispatches it again for the published release, as the operator actions guide describes; close this request with the listing's link once the registry shows the version.

steps.title: Announcement posted on GitHub Discussions
steps.action: Post the reviewed announcement {input.discussion.hash} of Vericairn {subject.version} in the Announcements category of github.com/orgs/Vericairn/discussions
steps.recovery: The operator posts exactly the reviewed text and closes this request with the discussion's link; a changed draft is reviewed again before it is posted.

steps.title: Summary posted on the operator's X account
steps.action: Post the reviewed summary {input.x-post.hash} of Vericairn {subject.version} on the operator's X account
steps.recovery: The operator posts exactly the reviewed text and closes this request with the post's link; a changed draft is reviewed again before it is posted.

steps.title: Profile repository's documents cleared
steps.action: Revise the profile repository's documents for the published version: its README's current release, install commands and links at the new tag. The operator merges the profile's change, its public front door, and each document is reviewed at that commit.
steps.recovery: A profile document that needs change stays due until it is revised, merged by the operator and reviewed.
